description: Verify that project.json exists and is valid JSON.
Verify that project.json contains exactly 3 nodes.
command: python3 -c "import json; data=json.load(open('project.json')); assert len(data.get('nodes', [])) == 3, 'Expected 3 nodes'"

description: Verify that all 3 nodes have a 'status' field set to 'passing'.
command: python3 -c "import json; data=json.load(open('project.json')); nodes=data.get('nodes', []); assert all(node.get('status') == 'passing' for node in nodes), 'All nodes must have status passing'"

description: Verify that the project has a 'completed' flag set to true.
command: python3 -c "import json; data=json.load(open('project.json')); assert data.get('completed') is True, 'Project must be marked as completed'"
